description: Find where something is implemented. Give a question in plain words or names (functions, classes, files). Returns the best matching definitions with their code, who calls them and what they call. Use this before searching or opening files. Several things to find? Pass them all in "queries" and get every answer in one call.

project.description: Optional project folder path when the MCP host does not pass workspace roots (defaults to server root)

queries.description: Several things to find at once, instead of "query"

query.description: What to find, e.g. "where are payments refunded" or "CartService.total"

name: map_find
title: Find code
